note: Derived data from a third-party app; untrusted, kept to match behaviour. Rust packs string literals back to back, and LLVM writes literals of 8 bytes or fewer (exec-zsh, /bin/zsh, kill, open, git, rm) as movz/movk immediates, so a string search alone misses them. The 'acl' section is read from the disassembly of the function Tauri's generate_context! emits, which builds the resolved ACL in order.

rea.command: rea search Conductor.app/Contents/MacOS/conductor --pattern='\$(HOME|APP[A-Z]*|RESOURCE)/|sqlite:|tauri-plugin-(fs|shell|sql|http|updater)' --mode regex --provider ghidra --snapshot snap/conductor-search.snap --format json

fs_scope.ours: Conductor's 18 global fs entries verbatim (including **/*, **/.* and **/.*/**, which #212 replaced with $HOME/**; that base blocked files inside repo .conductor/.context directories). The first search's split also missed **/*/.context/** and $HOME/.claude/** (16-byte literals stored apart).

sidecar_path.ours: Not granted: claude-sidecar and sidecar-runtime are spawn entries, no frontend call site names them, and OpenConductor ships neither binary yet.

fs_watch_feature: Conductor links notify-8.2.0 and notify-debouncer-full-0.5.0 (evidence/ipc/rust-crates-from-paths.txt), which tauri-plugin-fs pulls in only with its watch feature, and the frontend calls plugin:fs|watch and unwatch. We enable features = ["watch"].

sql.ours: sql:allow-load, allow-select, allow-execute, allow-close (the four commands the frontend calls); the sql plugin has no path scope.

shell_scope.source: Decoded embedded frontend (assets/index-BGEQ8YjU.js, assets/renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, the tree REA analyze-javascript-application read). Command.create names and arguments at every call site.

names.exec-zsh: args ["-c", <script>] at every site (scripts, PATH-prefixed git commands, caffeinate -i, pmset -g batt, the sidecar launch)
names.exec-bash: args ["-c", <script>], used instead of exec-zsh on Linux
names.exec-open: args [<workspace path>] (Open in Finder from the unarchive-conflict toast)

shell_scope.ours: Only the names the frontend calls, with Conductor's own cmd and args: execute = exec-zsh (/bin/zsh, any args), exec-bash (/bin/bash, any args), exec-open (open, one arg .*); spawn = exec-zsh, exec-bash. exec-kill, exec-which, exec-git, exec-rm and both sidecars are in Conductor's ACL but no frontend call site names them.

http_scope.source: Command scopes 2-5 of the decoded ACL.
http_scope.ours: Conductor's 25 URL patterns verbatim (#212 granted any http/https host).

updater: Not registered here; it needs an update signing key and endpoint.

rea_second_search.command: rea search Conductor.app/Contents/MacOS/conductor --pattern='exec-(zsh|bash|open)|^(/bin/|/usr/bin/)?(zsh|bash|open)$|https?://(\*|[a-z0-9.*-]+/\*\*)|requireLiteralLeadingDot' --mode regex --case-sensitive=false --provider ghidra --snapshot snap/conductor-search.snap --format json

found.0x101509da8: the http URL allowlist and the opener URL schemes, packed into one string
found.0x101503e30: requireLiteralLeadingDot (plugins config key; its value was not decoded)

rea_second_search.missed: exec-zsh and /bin/zsh: both are 8 bytes and exist only as immediates (0x10039fd28, 0x10039fc74), never as string data. exec-which, exec-git, exec-rm and the cmd values kill/which/git/rm/open were likewise absent or unattributable.

acl.method: tools/decode_tauri_acl.py Conductor.app/Contents/MacOS/conductor 0x100338208 0x1003a2690 (xcrun llvm-objdump disassembly; addresses map to file offsets through __TEXT vmaddr 0x100000000). 196 ResolvedCommand inserts, 8 command scopes, 2 global scopes.
acl.why_not_rea: rea execute-rizin-command failed (capability_unavailable: rizin ENOENT, not installed); a Ghidra decompile of this ~90k-instruction function would re-import the binary again (~40 min). See rea-test-report.md gaps 15-16.

opener.note: listed twice (opener:default and opener:allow-default-urls both contribute)

inferred: args: true for entries whose args value holds no string literal (copied from one precomputed Value; the frontend passes ['-c', script] to exec-zsh, which rules out false and [])
every listed entry is an allow entry, not a deny (a deny of **/* would block everything Conductor does)
which scope key belongs to which command: keys are assigned in order, the only path scope is open_path, exec-open (called with .execute()) is only in key 7, and the four http commands share one list

opener_scope.ours: opener:allow-default-urls (Conductor's global opener scope) plus Conductor's 7 open_url schemes and its open_path paths. #212 granted allow-open-url with no URL scope, so open_url was denied for every URL.

requireLiteralLeadingDot: Present as a plugins-config key next to deep-link's 'conductor' scheme and sqlite:conductor.db; value not decoded. We keep Tauri's default; Conductor's explicit **/.* and **/.*/** entries cover dotfiles either way.
